description: This Java class defines a specialized event object 'LoanTransactionMinimalBusinessEvent' used within integration tests for external event handling in the Apache Fineract project. It extends 'BusinessEvent' and adds specific fields related to loan transactions, such as amount and reversed status. It also provides a verify method to check if the external event payload matches its data.

classes.name: LoanTransactionMinimalBusinessEvent
classes.description: A class representing a minimal loan transaction event for integration testing, extending the BusinessEvent class with additional fields and verification logic.

methods.name: LoanTransactionMinimalBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event with type, business date, amount, and reversed status.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies whether the external event payload matches this event's data, including amount and reversed status.
